name: hypes
description: Adapt responses to what the user understands and carry forward only confirmed, scoped explanation clues.

interface.shortDescription: Clear, natural responses for what matters now
interface.longDescription: Hypes follows the user's understanding through a conversation and carries forward only confirmed concept relationships and explanation clues for the relevant topic, task, and responsibility. It keeps no raw conversation and does not reduce the user to a general skill level or personality. Its MCP transport is sessionless, while the private cognitive model remains on this Mac across plugin updates.
defaultPrompt: Use Hypes to make this response clear, natural, and appropriately detailed.
Explain this without repeating what I already understand.
Teach this interactively, but stop asking once I can apply it.
Tell me what materially changed, roughly where the work stands, and what remains.
Remove unnecessary headings and explanations of internal process from this draft.
Tell me briefly what Hypes changed or took into account in this response.
Tell me what you currently believe I understand and what still seems unclear.
